searchText: About SELFDESTRUCT. If I remember correctly, there was an idea to allow ephemeral SELFDESTRUCT within a transaction, a pattern used by some contracts. That way it's more backwards-compatible than the outright deactivation. Yes, I'm not sure if we ever spec'ed this, or assessed the % of "damage" it would prevent How do clients deal with breaking changes to their DB format? Do you require people to resync? Do you avoid them as much as possible? Do you have some kind of db migration tool? yes to all three We try to avoid them as much as possible, try to provide tools where possible (e.g. switch encoding of old receipts) and if thats not possible (e.g. crunching through the full state) we require users to resync
